payload.message: ⚠️ 'Exploits in DeFi protocols such as Aave and Compound are key deterrents for institutions,' per JPMorgan's new analysis. Flat TVL reinforces why big players are hesitant on broader crypto uptake. Still, keep in mind these are high-level observations, not incident specifics.

🛡️ These Apple refund phishing emails with 'Refund Processing Contact' subjects mirror last week's scam where scammers posed as banks for fake overpayments. Both push replies to non-Apple addresses and dangle varying refund amounts to hook users. Watch for storage change excuses in the body, just like those earlier waves.

⚠️ Look for phishing emails to your senior staff that use LinkedIn-scraped details to impersonate Palo Alto Networks recruiters. They push fake ATS fixes for $400–$800 with high-pressure tactics. Legit ones never charge fees.
